---
title: "Vignettes"
description: "OpenRBQM package vignettes and documentation."
---

Vignettes and articles fetched from each OpenRBQM package, listed by package in
the same order as the [Packages](packages.qmd) tab.

```{r setup}
#| echo: false
#| include: false

# Reusable logic lives in R/ (see R/github.R, R/vignettes.R).
invisible(lapply(list.files("R", pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE), source))
```

```{r vignette-listing}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# orgs, vignette_exclude, and curated_order come from R/config.R (sourced above),
# so ordering/exclusions stay in sync with the Packages tab.
cat(render_vignettes(orgs, exclude = vignette_exclude, curated = curated_order))
```
